ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' recurring Charges for the terminated Services. IBM will refund to Customer any prepaid Charges for the period after the effective date of termination.

input.comment: [Playbook] We accept the early termination charge mechanic but need it capped at three months' recurring Charges and paired with a refund of prepaid Charges, consistent with our playbook position that convenience termination should not carry an open-ended penalty.
input.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' recurring Charges and add pro-rata refund of prepaid Charges.
